anh_en: An underwater tunnel connecting Bjartr Woods to Sundermere. Rebuilt with a new blueprint, the tunnel now withstands the tectonic shifts caused by the Exostrider's greatsword. Beyond improved durability, its transparent structure offers travelers a stunning panoramic experience.
Whenever this road is used, gain Service Credit <texture=/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconA80/T_IconA80_Act_01_UI.T_IconA80_Act_01_UI,0.48> x{0}

An underwater tunnel connecting Bjartr Woods to Sundermere. Deep under the seabed, the Exostrider's greatsword causes unusual tectonic shifts, frequently compromising the integrity of the tunnel's rushed and flawed design.
The main road linking Startorch Academy and the Spacetrek Observatory. Students often pull over here to capture the colossal silhouette of the Observatory against the distant sky.
Whenever this road is used, gain Service Credit <texture=/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconA80/T_IconA80_Act_01_UI.T_IconA80_Act_01_UI,0.48> x{0}

<color=#ddc992>This old-model Route Constructor can only be activated using the special materials obtained from "Fire It Up! Route Constructor!".</color>\nThe main road linking Startorch Academy and the Spacetrek Observatory. The now desolate, muddy path still bears the marks of the convoys that once struggled through here.
Student of the Department of Light Energy Sciences

A cliffside road carved into the mountain. Researchers studying Lahai-Roi's terrain often marvel at the vast, arcing walls. When convoys pass through, echoes rise from the valley's depths as if answering their awe.
Whenever this road is used, gain Service Credit <texture=/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconA80/T_IconA80_Act_01_UI.T_IconA80_Act_01_UI,0.48> x{0}
A cliffside road carved into the mountain. The Void Storm that ravaged the Observatory erased this route as well, leaving only the wind's scream where traffic once passed.
Student of the Department of Exostrider Engineering
A cliffside road carved into the mountain, linking the Spacetrek Observatory with the broader southern Lahai-Roi. A waterfall shrouded in mist marks the road's end.
Whenever this road is used, gain Service Credit <texture=/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconA80/T_IconA80_Act_01_UI.T_IconA80_Act_01_UI,0.48> x{0}
A cliffside road carved into the mountain. After the Void Storm destroyed the northern section, this stretch too fell into decay, its cracked surface now buried beneath sand and dirt.
Student of the Department of Voidmatters Science

A key link between the primary network and the cliffside roads. When headlights cut through the sandy wind, travelers can't help but glance toward the distant sandstorm, catching glimpses of a giant shadow moving within.
Whenever this road is used, gain Service Credit <texture=/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconA80/T_IconA80_Act_01_UI.T_IconA80_Act_01_UI,0.48> x{0}
Loose soil covers this broken roadway. Once a key link between the primary network and the cliffside roads, it is now all but impassable.
A level waterside road offering a sweeping view. Under the Reactor's glow, the lake shimmers with flecks of light. As you pass, the reflected shoreline shifts and dances across the ripples.
Whenever this road is used, gain Service Credit <texture=/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconA80/T_IconA80_Act_01_UI.T_IconA80_Act_01_UI,0.48> x{0}
A level road tracing the lakeshore. Even its sweeping views cannot restore the vitality the pavement itself has lost.

A long highway stretching across southern Lahai-Roi. With the Solisylum's approval, the Spacetrek Collective expanded Godhfavn, turning it into a fully developed highway. Out of respect to the Roya, the original name was preserved and translated as Sol's Embrace.
Whenever this road is used, gain Service Credit <texture=/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconA80/T_IconA80_Act_01_UI.T_IconA80_Act_01_UI,0.48> x{0}
A long highway stretching across southern Lahai-Roi, initially a natural path leading to Bjartr Woods. The Roya refer to it as Godhfavn, meaning "embrace of the divine."

A road connecting the Howling Tunnel to Startorch Academy. Compared to other roads near the Academy, the Starleap Ascent is of moderate length and has varying road conditions, making it one of the main sites for students' expedition motorbike tests.
Whenever this road is used, gain Service Credit <texture=/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconA80/T_IconA80_Act_01_UI.T_IconA80_Act_01_UI,0.48> x{0}
A road connecting the Howling Tunnel to Startorch Academy. Damage has rendered its steep incline nearly impossible to traverse.

After reinforcing the rock walls and paving the highway, the tunnel can now accommodate heavy transport, shortening the journey from Startorch Academy to southern Lahai-Roi. The winds that once echoed here are now said to carry a different meaning: they are the Exostrider's blessing for Roya students heading to the Academy.
Whenever this road is used, gain Service Credit <texture=/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconA80/T_IconA80_Act_01_UI.T_IconA80_Act_01_UI,0.48> x{0}
The winds roar through this massive natural tunnel, like the rumbling of the Exostrider's throat. The Roya call it Jotunhals, meaning "throat of the Exostrider."

A grand bay bridge linking Bjartr Woods to the Etching Plains and Startorch Academy. For Roya students bound for the Academy, the bridge is a gateway to a new life. With anticipation, anxiety, and excitement, they step onto it and begin their academic journey.
Whenever this road is used, gain Service Credit <texture=/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/Common/Image/IconA80/T_IconA80_Act_01_UI.T_IconA80_Act_01_UI,0.48> x{0}
A grand bay bridge linking Bjartr Woods and the Etching Plains. Several years ago, a tremor from Sundermere fractured its structure, and it eventually collapsed after seasons of erosion.

You wake to the voice of two girls, Yangyang and Chixia. You remember nothing of your past and know little of the present, but the abilities you display show that you are no ordinary person.\n\nGuided by them, you begin to learn the ways of this world. When you encounter the statue of Sentinel Jué, a fragment of memory stirs, leading you toward Jinzhou City to search for the truth about yourself.

On the road, you absorb an Echo directly with your body. This unusual ability draws your new friends' attention. Chixia suggests you collect more Echoes along the way to Jinzhou City, but your second attempt fails.\n\nWith no idea how it works, you continue your journey to Jinzhou City to look for answers, unaware that a mysterious girl is watching your every step...

Your journey takes you to the City Hall, where the Magistrate of Jinzhou, Jinhsi, has summoned you. But Jinhsi is not there. Her bodyguard, Sanhua, hands you three tokens and promises a meeting in three days.
 
Yangyang urges you to seek out Huaxu Academy, where Baizhi works, for clues about the tokens. There, the first token reveals a past connection between you and Jinzhou.
 
 Your actions seem to draw many eyes. Who plays the predator, and who the prey?

The second token leads you and Yangyang to somewhere outside the city.

As you make your way out, you run into Jianxin, a young Taoist searching for a missing person. With your clearance, you bring her along past the city walls. The three of you arrive at the Midnight Rangers' Rearguard Camp, where the shadow of war looms over the horizon. Clues from the quartermaster reveal that the second token is somehow connected to the coming war.

After the matter is settled, you find yourself caught in an illusion. When you snap out of it, Yangyang's words help you realize where the final token leads: Qichi Village in the Central Plains.

When you and Yangyang reach Qichi Village, you are shocked to find it has become a Tacet Field. Your investigation is then cut short by Scar, an Overseer of the Fractsidus. He reveals the tragic events that befell Qichi Village and invites you to join him. You refuse, and the confrontation escalates into a battle.\n\nIn the chaos, a mysterious girl intervenes to cover Scar's retreat. Having gathered the information on all three tokens, you return to Jinzhou City.

With all the clues gathered, you unlock the sundial device. Hidden inside is a slip of paper pointing you to your next destination, the heavily guarded Grand Library.\n\nAs you enter the Library, Scar follows you in. But by this time, you have already met Jinhsi, and with your help, she captures Scar. From him, Jinhsi learns a shocking truth and advises you to seek an organization called the Black Shores, saying your ties to them run deep.

You find Aalto and Encore, Consultants of the Black Shores. Aalto agrees to tell you about your origins but only if you join them in investigating the Court of Savantae Ruins.

There, you discover that the Court of Savantae once tried to use an artificial Retroact Rain to trace something back in time, but the experiment failed, creating a monster. After defeating the monster, Aalto tells you that your journey once took you to the Black Shores before.

Just then, a real Retroact Rain begins to fall, and a wave of Tacet Discords strikes Jinzhou City.

Fighting alongside the people of Jinzhou, you help hold back the TD outbreak. Jinhsi confirms this was foretold by the Sentinel. With Yangyang at your side, you head to the Desorock Highland to meet Jiyan.\n\nOn the road, you are attacked by the Thundering Mephis, but Jiyan arrives just in time to help, and together you defeat the enemy. Back at the Midnight Rangers camp, you and Jiyan plan to use the Disruptor to break the Threnodian's defenses.

The Disruptor shatters the barrier protecting the Threnodian. Under the cover of your allies, you and Jiyan fight your way to the heart of the Threnodian, and together, you engage in a grueling battle against the powerful Dreamless. In the heat of battle, you unexpectedly absorb its Havoc power. As it tries to kill you, a little creature pops out of your hand and absorbs the attack, ending the crisis.\n\nThe Threnodian flees, and the dust settles. With the help of Jiyan, Yangyang, and all your allies, you manage to save Jinzhou.

Jinhsi disappears while checking on the Sentinel's safety alone. You and Changli set out for Mt. Firmament to find her.

In the mountains, time has spiraled out of control. Jinhsi refuses Jué's offer to sacrifice itself, choosing instead to fight the Sentinel as fate decrees. You witness her battle, and with your approval, Jué transfers its Temporal Mandate to Jinhsi, returning Jinzhou's future to its people.

When all is done, Jué suggests you visit the Black Shores to explore the past of you and Abby.

Data brought back from the Port City of Guixu contaminates the Tethys System and fills the Black Shores with corrupted frequencies.\n\nThe administrator of the Black Shores, Shorekeeper, reveals that you were once the Chief Steward of this place, but remains silent about the buried past... Eventually, the corruption is cleansed. With the clearance Shorekeeper returns to you, you manually reset the algorithm of the Tethys System. The lost souls trapped in the system at last find peace, and Shorekeeper regains her freedom.

Outside Panhua's Restaurant, you meet Yangyang and Chixia again. You have fully assimilated the Threnodian's power that the "little one" who now lives inside of you had absorbed.\n\nThe "little one", oblivious of its origin, turns down Chixia's suggestions for its new name, but loves the one you randomly come up: Abby. Hoping to find clues in Abby's special abilities, you discover that it cannot use them for now. You decide to consult the Sentinel and the Magistrate when you meet again.

Yangyang, Chixia, and Baizhi invite you to join them for the Moon-Chasing Festival. At the Wishing Tree, you meet Xiangli Yao and learn that he is the mysterious wish granter. You agree to help him investigate four wishes containing abnormal data.\n\nTogether, you explore the abnormal Sonoro Sphere, uncovering Xiangli Yao's past and addressing the wishers' problems. At the end of the festival, you and your friends take a commemorative photo under the moonlight.

The Liondance Troupe is gearing up for a new performance. Lingyang invites you out for a meal while scouting potential customers along the way. At the last stop, you learn a food stall owner has been threatened by something called the "Jingle Beast" and a gang known as "The Savages." Moved by his story and a request from the Bei siblings, you expose the gang's scheme, and in doing so, come to learn the secret Lingyang has been carrying. After the lion dance, Lingyang tells you an old legend about the "Jingle Beast"...

A team set to compete in the Jinzhou Riverside Games suffers an accident. You came only to watch, but you invite Jiyan to join you in filling the vacant spot. At the end of the race, the Gulpuffs suddenly erupt into chaos. To find the source of the anomaly, you trace it to a Sonoro Sphere upstream. After a fierce battle, you free the reverberations of Jiyan's fallen comrades from within it...

Several residents of Jinzhou City have gone missing recently. As you investigate, you cross paths with an organization known as the Séance Society, as well as Patroller Yinlin, who is investigating them too. Working in tandem, you and Yinlin set out to uncover the truth behind the group. In the end, you defeat its leader, the Dollmaker, and bring him to justice. Then Yinlin bids you farewell and departs on a new journey of her own.

Changli asks to meet you at the pavilion, and to uncover the Secret of Immortality hidden within an unfinished Weiqi game, the two of you once again venture into Mt. Firmament. Through the machinations of the Fractsidus, the adventurer Wuli, trying to save his lover Fuling, is swept into a Temporal Disruption and survives only because you arrive in time. Within the Sonoro Sphere, you witness Changli's past and recover scattered fragments of your own. After the remaining Fractsidus members are captured, Wuli and Fuling decide to keep chasing distant horizons, and you and Changli play out the final moves of the Weiqi game...

Rumor speaks of an Arcane Artist in Jinzhou whose paintings can come to life. While investigating that artist at a client's request, you meet Zhezhi, who is looking into the same matter. Together, you discover that the mysterious artist, Mingyan, already knows Zhezhi and is being forced to forge her work. Determined to bring the mastermind's crimes to light, Zhezhi confronts the Shanyun Art Exchange in open court. With your support, she wins the argument and exposes the truth...

To find the wish-granting relics from Encore's story, you, Encore, and a young listener named Ying, who holds the treasure map, set out on an adventure together. Along the way, Ying learns that she will never see her mother again, and you discover that this story was a gift Encore's mother left for her. Wanting to give the tale a happy ending, Encore gathers everyone's signature flowers and asks Verina to create the final treasure, fulfilling both her own wish and Ying's. Then you and Encore makes a pinky promise to write new stories together in the future.

A corrupted Stellar Matrix has escaped the Error Cell and may threaten the safety of the Black Shores. To track it down, you need Camellya's help. As the investigation unfolds, the past you shared with Camellya, or rather with "Lady Flora," slowly comes to light. After crossing countless junctures, the two of you find each other again, along with the core of the corrupted Stellar Matrix. You meet Camellya at Veiled Rock, where the many timelines overlap and become one the moment she offers you a flower.

Before your eyes, the Mourning Aix is reunited with its mate in their final moments. The researcher Jiuyue chooses to carry the memory of a loved one and move forward, and at last, the fog over Whining Aix's Mire is dispersed. This may not be an ending, but rather the beginning of a new story.
You help Shicheng complete the Rite of Offering that has been passed down for generations, and she resolves to carry the tradition forward.
A girl from Hongzhen named Shicheng wishes to perform the Rite of Offering, but she is attacked by TDs. You manage to save her just in time.
You and Shicheng climb to the peak of the arch-shaped rock and complete the rite.
You and Shicheng travel to where the waterfalls converge and complete the rite.
You and Shicheng reach the shoals and islands and complete the rite.
You and Shicheng come to the boundary of yellow and white and complete the rite.
You and Shicheng enter the Offering Site and complete the final rite.

Using the Prototype Chronosorter, you repair the damaged Woodveil Hall, and the once-withered Tianqu Tree springs back to life. Afterward, you tell the relic merchant Chenpi everything that happened here, and the story set in motion by a single ancient artifact finally comes to a close.

To find the gift her sister Shiyu left behind, you accompany Shixia through waterfalls and across open wilds on a journey through memories that belong only to her. When Shixia realizes that her sister's "gift" was simply the vast landscape beneath her feet, and a wish for Shixia to move forward bravely, she decides to climb the even steeper West Mountain with you, just as Shiyu once did.

After crossing a harsh mountain path, the two of you reach the top of West Mountain at sunrise. At the summit, Shixia realizes that her sister has always been watching over her and encouraging her. She resolves to face the future with courage.
Back at the theater, Shixia, just like Shiyu before her, encourages a little girl named Mumin to move forward bravely as well.

Following the guidance from your past self and the Tethys system, you set sail for Rinascita to find Imperator and seek solutions to Abby's weakening frequencies.

Cetus the Tidebreaker attacks at sea, but Brant, captain of the Fool's Troupe, helps you through the mist. You two promise to meet again at the opening of the Carnevale.

Upon arriving in Ragunna, you see strange "pilgrimages," and a playwright steps forward to explain their origins.

Led by Acolyte Phoebe, you enter this city of Echoes and come to understand the significance of Echoes to Rinascita. While dealing with the Montelli family, who sent the invitation to the Black Shores, you resonate with an out-of-control Vitreum Dancer and receive a plea for help from the Sentinel. As you investigate the cause of this incident, you catch a glimpse of undercurrents beneath Ragunna: the secretive dealings between the Order, the nobles, and the Fractsidus. Phrolova, a Fractsidus Overseer you once met briefly, also watches from the shadows.

Gilberto has gone mad, and Lorelei of Nimbus Sanctum has fallen under the influence of the mysterious Lycoris. After helping Lorelei regain her senses, you learn that the only way to reach the Sentinel is to claim the Laurel at the Carnevale.

You work with Carlotta from the Montelli family to return the damaged Vitreum Dancer back to Averardo Vault. Clues along the journey lead to a shocking truth: Rinascita has two divinities.

Carlotta stays behind to hold off the Order's pursuers, while you make for a northern island where another secret of the Order lies hidden.

On the bridge to the island, you are attacked by the Dragon of Dirge, and Roccia of the Fool's Troupe comes to your aid. In the Penitent's End, you learn the truth behind the "pilgrimages" and regroup with Carlotta. You decide to join forces with the Fool's Troupe to win the Laurel at the Carnevale. However, Phrolova moves to disrupt the festivity.\n \nAfter defeating her, you finally speak to the Sentinel, who tells you that "The Lost"—They wish you to help—is among the people at the Carnevale.

The Lost turns out to be Cartethyia, the Blessed Maiden who should have martyred herself. Together with Cantarella, head of the Fisalia family, you travel to the Avinoleum Theological Seminary to meet her.

As you explore the Seminary, Cartethyia's true origin comes to light. She is a creation of the Threnodian. She asks you to end her life once and for all, but you refuse her request.

With the help of many, the crisis is finally resolved, and Cartethyia gains a new life. In the Sentinel's final moments, They tell you the truth of history.

Cartethyia suddenly disappears, and following the clues she left behind, you arrive in Septimont, where you meet the prodigy gladiator, Lupa. To learn Cartethyia's whereabouts, you choose to team up with Lupa and win the Great Agon of Septimont. In between the events, Phrolova hands you a script and warns that Lupa will draw the Dark Tide. Meanwhile, the story of Mya seems to hint at something more… Eventually, you and Lupa win the championship, while Cartethyia fights alongside you in a way no one else can perceive.

You and Lupa head for the Central Hub. Lupa becomes frenzied and destroys its control panel. You manage to separate her from Mya, who has become a vessel of the Threnodian, and send Lupa to the beginning of the "story." There, she retrieves her lost memories and learns about Mya's fate. She then duels the Lady of the Sea and reclaims peace for Septimont. Although Cristoforo escapes Cartethyia's attack, the crisis in Septimont comes to a close, and you, Lupa, and Cartethyia finally reunite.

While searching for the residual energy of the Threnodian, you are struck into the sea by Fenrico and saved by Phrolova. To reach your goal, you decide to work with her temporarily. Inside the Sonoro she created, "the Beyond," you learn about her past, and that you once broke a promise to her.\n\nIn Fenrico's final moment, the Lantern wakes him from the Threnodian's control. He sacrifices himself to seal the gateway to the Journeying Paradise and stops the Dark Tide. But the Gem holding the Threnodian's power is taken by the Fractsidus.

Augusta invites you to join her on the hunt. But when you fight the Dark Tide entity, "the False Sovereign," an unseen force intervenes, causing the attempt to fail.\n\nTo stop the Dark Tide from spreading, you track the False Sovereign to Murmurstown. There, you and Augusta fight side by side to bring it down. The Dark Tide then subsides, and you recover the Relic of Imperator. But as you savor your victory, Cristoforo is already plotting his next move…

After the successful hunt of the False Sovereign, you discover everyone except you has forgotten about the existence of Iuno. The people attribute every one of her past deeds to you. To bring Iuno, who vanished into the moon, back to existence and rewrite her ending, you follow the guide of her bracelet and head off to the Chaos as suggested by Avidius and Lillibet. Finally, you "anchor" her amidst the Chaos and bring the unwritten future back to Septimont, and to her.

Ragunna comes under attack by the Dark Tide, its creations appearing across the city. Avidius joins you in the hunt, but during the pursuit, he gradually uncovers the truth of himself. At the end of his life, he absorbs the Dark Tide and ends the crisis in Ragunna.\n\nIt is then that you realize you have long been secretly corrupted by the Dark Tide and have now become Leviathan's Harbinger. To end the crisis once and for all, you set out for Septimont once more with the mysterious Discord Slayer Galbrena.

An abnormal High Tide strikes Septimont. To stem the Dark Tide, the people of Ragunna come to aid the city, and the Black Shores send every Bloom Bearer still able to fight. Galbrena goes headfirst into the Dark Tide. You and your companions soon follow suit and take the plunge carrying the lantern brought by Qiuyuan.\n \nAfter all the hardship, you finally see the light of hope. You and the people of Rinascita together defeat the Threnodian revived by the Gem. Rinascita gets the peace it deserves at last.

With the chain of events at Rinascita finally concluded, you return once more to the Black Shores. Unexpectedly, the Tethys System detects a strange frequency and isolates from it a set of coordinates. As you trace the coordinates, a spatial rift leading to an unknown Sonoro Sphere tears open at sea close to the Black Shores. During the investigation, you are pulled into the rift and soon awaken in a ruined, restless city. And as the situation grows dire, a mysterious black-haired girl appears before you…

At a tavern, you meet the traveling poet Nestor, who shares with you Ephor Augusta's stories. Before rising to power, she was an ordinary girl with no outstanding gift, yet she grew through countless trials to seize the championship and claim victory and glory. At the same time, Augusta and Iuno have readied themselves for the hunt in the Sanguis Plateaus.

As the Dark Tide closed in, at a personal request from someone in Mingting, Qiuyuan journeyed to Ragunna to your aid. After rescuing an Acolyte in Ragunna, he traveled to the Fabricatorium of the Deep, where he convinced Fenrico to yield the First Relic, a key instrument in stopping the Dark Tide. Then he arrived just in time for the final battle to deliver the Relic to you.\n\nAfter the war, Ciaccona recounts Qiuyuan's deeds in Rinascita. You later find Qiuyuan at the dock as he prepares to depart, and express your gratitude.

You travel to the Black Shores to visit Chisa, only to learn that during her recovery, she had secretly gone alone to Honami City. Burdened by the truth that over two decades have passed in the outside world, she feels uncertain about the future. Together, you stroll through Sakura Quarter to ease her mind. Under the falling petals, she bares her feelings to you and gives you your old student ID card along with a carefully prepared gift. To your surprise, you discover you were once a member of Startorch Academy. Chisa then suggests inviting your friends from the Black Shores to Shashou Cafe to give it a proper "opening"…

An invitation draws you into the dangerous undercurrents of the Montelli family. To investigate the mysterious death of one of its members, you join forces with Carlotta once more. When the truth is finally stripped bare, it points to the sender of the invitation: Carlotta's uncle, Capollo. Carlotta evades his snare and reunites with you, and together you destroy the plan he had devised with the Order of the Deep. Before parting, Carlotta gives you a Cat's Eye gem...

To lift the spirits of the Pilgrims they rescued, Roccia decides to stage a welcome play and perform "Pegasus" with the troupe. In search of the perfect stage prop, a "star," the two of you return to the Strand, only to become trapped in a maze of fog. At its far end, you discover plushies and the "star" who are looking for their owners. You bring them back to the troupe, and the performance is a success. After the curtain falls, the plushies finally reunite with their owners, and Roccia invites you to join the troupe...

After accidentally winning a wager, you become captain of the Troupe of Fool for a day. You and Brant set off in search of lost treasure and cross paths with the greedy pirate Aldric. At the heart of the hidden treasure, Brant sticks to the plan, taking only the sea chart before slipping away with you. Aldric, however, is consumed by his own greed and meets his end. When the adventure ends, Brant tells you the tale of the chart and the Golden Captain. You become the troupe's honorary captain, and the next adventure awaits somewhere on the horizon.

Guided by a message carrying a strange frequency, you arrive in Egla Town and join Cantarella for the Night of Remembrance. When you retire to the Porto-Veno Castle to rest, past and present begin to overlap within its halls, leading you to the answer behind the festival's riddles: the Divine Trials held by the Fisalia family. With your help, Cantarella returns the girls she once saved during those trials, and the dreamy illusion of the night fades away in a veil of gentle smoke.

The Black Alley and Talos, both destroyed years ago at the hands of the Blazing Nightwalker, suddenly reappear in Ragunna. You begin investigating alongside Zani. In the course of that search, you learn that Zani herself is the Blazing Nightwalker. After a hard-fought adventure, you defeat the current Talos and rescue the residents suffering under her tyranny. Zani then tells you why she became the Nightwalker: to protect the precious, fragile peace of ordinary life. That, she says, is how heroes are born.

To find Liel, the missing companion of the Exile Insula, you enter the Twilight Rise with him. There, you become trapped for a time and are attacked by an unknown monster. You eventually find a way out, but Liel is nowhere to be found.

You then enter the Resounding Rise with Liel's sister, Itzel. There, you encounter the same unknown monster again and discover that the Fanatic Shark gang, responsible for Liel's disappearance, has itself been wiped out by the creature. Within the tower, you uncover the reason the Fisalia family built the Thorncrown Rises. Sadly, Liel still remains missing.

Following the monster's frequency, you, Insula, and Itzel enter the Command Rise and uncover a secret weapon created by the Fisalia family. At last, you catch up with the monster and defeat it, but by then, Liel is already dead. After thanking you for your help, the Exiles decide to leave Rinascita behind.

You complete the trial on the Shores of Last Breath amid raging winds. Though you cannot help but question why the Sentinel and the Order would have set such a test, the truth has long since been buried by history.

The Acolyte Lenore asks you to recover the long-lost Nimbus Chorales. You gather its scattered parts in Nimbus Sanctum, but Lenore believes one final passage is still missing. At that moment, the lost Major Forbidden Archive reappears, and she asks you to enter it in search of the last part.

Deep within the Archive, you recover the missing part, only to find that it does not praise the Sentinel as Lenore expected, but the ancient people of Rinascita. She believes this runs counter to the Order's teachings, yet she is still moved by the emotions carried in the music. Until she can resolve the doubts it has stirred within her, she decides not to report it to the Order.

You, Phoebe, and Zani escort a "relic" entrusted to you by the Order into an unknown area deep within the Averardo Vault. There, you uncover the secret that the Montelli family once sheltered a group of artists and scientists from the Order. Though they are long dead, their Reverberations remain trapped within the vault. At the same time, you realize that the "relic" you brought inside is in fact a bomb the Order intended to use to erase its own crimes. \nPhoebe uses her power to defuse the crisis before anything happens, and with the imprisoned Reverberations finally set free, the vault's great doors swing open once more.

Guided by the Nimbus Wraiths, you free the memory fragments left behind by past candidates of the Divine Trials, and at "Lake of Spirits" you witness a breathtaking meteor shower. Traveling beside you, Cantarella makes a wish that one day the Fisalia family will be freed from the curse of the Threnodian, and that everyone will be able to enjoy life in peace and freedom.

In the ruins near the Ashen Dragon's Crypt, you find the Scourgewing, Iaen, trapped by hunters. From the nearby Reverberations, you learn that a Gladiator named Levis tried to rescue Iaen from them in defense of his honor, only to be trapped himself. In his final moments, Iaen creates an illusion so that Levis may finally lay his regrets to rest in one last duel.
Together with Tulia, you rescue the trapped Scourgewing, Isth, from a tower, and you also witness the undying friendship between fallen members of the Black Shores and Gladiators.

The Scourgewings you saved, Isth and Iaen, soar back into the sky as the wilds once ravaged by the Dark Tide slowly begin to recover. They will fly toward distant lands, while Tulia returns home to continue her research. Though you part for now, as long as you live beneath the same sky, you are certain to meet again.

Pursuing Phrolova's phantom, you descend deep into Mournfell Canyon, where you encounter Lenore and a man calling himself a Reverberation, Medulius. Your investigation reveals that Medulius came here to revel in the "blood duel" he himself set in motion, a father and daughter driven to kill one another, only to be cursed by Phrolova and denied the release of true death. After you defeat the Gladiator father and daughter, as well as Medulius, silence finally falls. You decide to continue the hunt for Phrolova, but are unsuccessful in locating her.
The recovery efforts in Rinascita after the Dark Tide leave Phoebe overwhelmed. You decide to help her by taking on some of the work in Septimont.

In the Mournfell Canyon, you meet Acolyte Lenore, the one Medulius once protected. Having returned from the Dark Tide, Lenore is burdened by guilt for having abetted evil and is unsure of what she should do now. With your encouragement, she decides to join the recovery efforts in Septimont and do whatever she can for others.

The rebuilding of Septimont's Old District moves forward smoothly thanks to everyone's hard work. You help Lenore face her fears and meet the Troupe of Fools, once oppressed by the Order, which loosens some of the knots still tied in her heart. In the end, she gives the Nimbus Chorales to the troupe and resolves to stop drowning in self-pity and find a way to keep living.

The celebration marking the completion of the small square begins. Amid joyful music, Lenore steps onto the stage and confesses what she truly wants: to keep helping people. As the Nimbus Chorales rise into the air, the final knot in her heart is released.

At sunrise, the celebration comes to a perfect close. Lenore tells you that when she let go of everything weighing her down and sang freely, she became a Resonator, awakening the power to "heal." She intends to use that gift to help Rinascita heal and do what she believes is right.

Septimont's Old District is showing signs of recovery. There, you see Julia Silva, once exiled and now returned, surrounded by jeering crowds. Ignoring their scorn, she takes her nephew Adric's spear and heads alone into the Mournfell Canyon, swearing to reclaim the Silvas' honor.

You and Lenore witness an argument between Luther and Alessio. Though innocent, Luther chooses not to abandon his colleague Alessio but to stand beside him and be judged by the people together. After they leave, you and Lenore talk about whether Julia and Luther truly deserve punishment. Lenore decides that she, too, must find the courage to change and make amends.

You set out on an adventure with the plushies of Plushie Village who long to explore the world. Along the way, you take plenty of photos for them. At one point, you even step alone into a strange world inside a painting and capture a one-of-a-kind night sky, unlike anything you've ever seen. Maybe that's what adventure is really about: finding unique sights in faraway places. Your journey inspires the other plushies too scared to leave before. In the end, the plushies who explored with you take a photo of you standing beneath the stars, then quietly add themselves into the picture.

When everything is over, you reunite with Cartethyia at a Septimontian plaza. Though a few regrets remain, she is content with a life in which she can cook the food she loves, travel freely, and meet the people she wishes to see.

After the dust settles, you share drinks with Lupa on the hotel terrace. In the warm evening light, she swears to you, and to the undying sun, that if you ever call for her, she will come to whatever battlefield awaits you.
Near the cable car, you meet Buling just before her holiday ends. Before leaving, she gives you a bronze mirror and says that perhaps the two of you will meet again someday.
You report the situation beneath the sea to Zani, the Black Shores, and Cartethyia, then decide to return to Septimont and investigate the truth behind the "Journeying Paradise."

A Hurriclaw named "Chunkie," corrupted by the Dark Tide while trying to save the old Gladiator Arctos and a little Wootter named "Teeny," keeps circling outside the camp. Together with Arctos, you free Chunkie from the Dark Tide. It scatters into the wind, leaving behind only a feather from Arctos's helmet. Arctos fastens the feather to the tail of the Hornett, hoping that Chunkie's will to protect others will live on in its cry and reach every Gladiator who hears it.

The old Gladiator Aeolus, whom you rescued during a scouting mission in the Wastelands, cannot stop dwelling on the past. He regrets being a coward and leaving Cato to face the Dark Tide alone. He wants to become the man who fought bravely instead. He joins you in killing a Kerasaur near camp, then after losing a sparring match with you, he leaves.

After leaving, Aeolus resolves to hunt a Corrosaurus alone. When you find him and the beast, the two of you defeat it together despite his injuries, but he does not survive. You return to camp bearing news of his death. Standing by his new sword grave, Rolla, who had always stayed by his side, tells him that in her heart, he was always a hero. Not because he chose to fight, but because he chose to save her from the Dark Tide.
A letter Ephor Augusta writes to the Gladiator Aeolus. She still remembers him as a worthy rival and rejects his request to leave the ranks.

You save a dying Aria Mummer and promise to fulfill its final wish by delivering Melody Boxes to the people they were meant for. As you carry them across the city, you witness one small life after another in Septimont. Through the melodies, people come to glimpse sides of their loved ones they never knew. After the last Melody Box is delivered, the Aria Mummer returns to the Resonance Nexus, leaving only a faint strain of music echoing in people's hearts.

The passage to Lahai-Roi finally opens. After parting ways with Namipon and Shorekeeper, Chisa and you enter the tunnel in turn. Along the way, you are dragged into a mysterious realm inhabited by a Threnodian. Just as your frequency is about to be consumed, a pink-haired girl appears, rescues you, and sends you back to reality.\nUpon reaching Lahai-Roi, you unexpectedly cross paths with a student named Lynae. She arrives on her motorbike, helps you escape an attack from a Voidworm, and brings you safely to your destination—Startorch Academy.

Once you complete the enrollment procedures, you officially become a student of Startorch Academy. At the Research Institute, you meet Professor Mornye and learn that the Spacetrek Collective is preparing for the crucial project, New Solar Ceremony. But before long, you are caught up in an incident triggered by Hyvatia's sudden malfunction. Lynae—present at the scene—becomes an immediate suspect, and together you begin to dig into the truth behind the chaos. Your investigation uncovers Lynae's hidden identity and a conspiracy orchestrated by the Fractsidus. In the end, you and Lynae lure away and defeat the Voidworm threatening the Academy, resolving the immediate danger. Yet the masterminds behind the plot remain at large, and their plans are far from over.

As the New Solar Ceremony approaches, you receive a plea for help, with its sender addressing you as Arbiter. Suspecting a link to the New Solar Ceremony, Mornye travels with you to Bjartr Woods to uncover the truth. There, you discover that the Fractsidus has deceived the Roya Tribe into triggering the Reactor Drive's fall. To ensure the successful launch of the artificial sun "Helios," Mornye enters the Drive herself. When the dust settles, a new dawn finally rises over Lahai-Roi.

After an ambush by the mysterious mech Sigillum, your frequency-loss symptoms worsen until Aemeath once again comes to your rescue. This digital ghost, visible only to you, has already died in the past, Overclocking to resonate with the Exostrider and protect Lahai-Roi. Now, to cure your symptoms and help Aemeath recover her "existence", the two of you journey to the Roya Frostlands. Along the way, you encounter Luuk Herssen. At the site where the Exostrider lies dormant, you confront and defeat Sigillum, uncovering the truth Aemeath has been hiding and witnessing her to become the savior.

With the New Solar Celebration just around the corner, a game mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus looms over the Academy like a lurking shadow. Together with Sigrika, you set out to investigate the mysterious frequency in the Dark Side and unravel the riddles surrounding it.\nWorking together, you manage to defeat the vortex left behind in the Dark Side, restoring a temporary calm. Yet you can't shake the feeling that more shadows are hidden, waiting beneath the peaceful facade of the evening for you to handle them.

After the Dark Side incident, the Fractsidus's real intentions remain unclear, and the Voidmatter beneath Lahai-Roi seems to be stirring again. With the help of Lucilla, Luuk Herssen, and others, you secure a chance to speak directly with the head of the Spacetrek Collective. In the end, he gives you the green light to activate and pilot the Exostrider. The road there is anything but easy, but with the help of "everyone", you drive back Aleph-1 from deep within Voidspace and bring Aemeath home. This time, the story written across Lahai-Roi, and across the past itself, becomes one that leads toward the future: a story in which the world saves its hero.

After your journey to the Roya Frostlands concludes, you head to the infirmary to discuss the Exostrider plan with Luuk Herssen. In his secret workspace, he explains the current status of the Fractsidus and why he has come to Lahai-Roi. A Fractsidus member has kidnapped the Royan student who once traveled with you, taking her to the abandoned space station. Together, you work to resolve the crisis. During the mission, however, you discover that another Fractsidus agent is still hiding within the Academy, waiting for the New Solar Ceremony to begin. Comforted by Luuk Herssen's words, you accept the candy he offers, and with renewed resolve, you regain your inner peace and determination.

After the New Solar Celebration concludes, Lucilla reveals that the root of the Dark Side anomaly remains unresolved. During your investigation, she discovers that the trap set by the Fractsidus specifically targets memory-type Resonators. Determined to draw the rabbit out, Lucilla volunteers to act as bait, but doing so means confronting her own vulnerabilities.\nHowever, Lucilla has learned to face her past with honesty long ago. She breaks the illusion, and, with your help, captures the rabbit. In doing so, the root of the Dark Side anomaly is finally eliminated.

Before setting out on the mission to defend the Dimmr Plains, Hiyuki travels alone to Honami. While helping the Black Shores deal with unresolved matters about the Left Behind, she also searches for traces of the previous Miko of Flaming Sakura. There, she unexpectedly runs into the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Even when faced with the Grand Architect's incendiary speech, Hiyuki keeps her blade sheathed...

Hiyuki raises her blade to bid farewell to the Left Behind of Honami, and to Lady Gyokuro, the former Miko of Flaming Sakura. Seeing Hiyuki's resolve, Gyokuro leaves her with one final blessing: that she no longer remain bound by fate, but step into a spring of her own as an ordinary person.

Denia, who was taken into custody after the final battle, has now woken up. The Spacetrek Collective hopes to cooperate with her and entrusts you with the negotiations. After speaking with her, you strike a bargain: she agrees to help the Collective and tell you what she knows about the Grand Architect, and in return, you spend her birthday with her at the Academy. That night, Denia finally tells you the truth about who she really is. There is no easy answer to her situation, but you speak from the heart, and that gives her the courage she needs.

The disappearance of the Exostrider led investors to question the very purpose of Rabelle College. Meanwhile, factions from the New Federation have begun harboring ulterior motives regarding the Synchronists. Inspired by the unwavering faith of her students, Lucilla, as both the Academy President and students' professor, has chosen the path that best serves their future: a daring breakthrough toward the Etheric Sea.

A Kronaclaw corrupted by the Void Storm leads you and its Shepherd, Skavitz, to the ruins of Upphaf Forest. Though already consumed by corruption, it still manages to return there and pour the last of its strength into the Life Chamber core. Under that core's power, the long-since withered forest slowly begins to recover. Spent and powerless, the bird flies off alone and disappears into Upphaf's frozen caverns.

Later, you and Skavitz find the Void Storm corrupted Kronaclaw once more. Unable to return to its flock and unwilling to endanger the others, it follows a Kronaclaw's instinct back to Upphaf Forest, the ancient homeland of its kind. There, you help free it from the torment of corruption. Returned at last to its home, it no longer has to fly alone.

Lenie, one of Warren's students, ventures into a contaminated Voidmatter zone in an attempt to prove herself and falls into danger. When you come to help, the two of you discover the first-generation Helios, a prototype Warren had abandoned years ago. With the help of several professors, you restore it, and Lenie finally finds her own path. She vows never to repeat Warren's mistakes. In the days ahead, she'll live up to her mentors' hopes and strive, like any true researcher, to bring hope and progress to humanity.

Sigrika discovers an ancient ruin still brimming with life. There, you find a very special feather. It leads you to Aurora Bridge, where you free an Auroraclaw trapped in ice. Once freed, the bird carries you and Sigrika into the sky. Beneath its wings, the world opens up below you. Wide, peaceful, and breathtaking.

A frail little girl named Misha asks you to help find the Soliskin stickers left by her mother, Vantier. While gathering them, you inadvertently learn that Vantier has already passed away. Having sensed the truth herself, Misha quietly slips away and passes on as well. Like the Soliskin, they will both become light, and in that warmth, they will meet again.

At Zahira's recommendation, you become a test volunteer helping rebuild the route network across the Etching Plains. With Elowyn's assistance, you restore the transport routes, and the lifelines of the plain begin to spread out beneath your feet once more.

Songdis, hopelessly absorbed in games, decides to create 8-bit chiptune music for the Roya. You go with her to Bjartr Woods, where you turn the melodies played by the Soliskin into a new song. With her wish fulfilled, she decides to put games aside for a while and throw herself into her studies, though she will never forget the memories those games and songs gave her.

A student named Ang, who loves stargazing, wants to watch the stars again with his old classmates. You help him invite them, along with Miss Dhalifa, to the Observatory. Beneath a sky glittering with stars, you take a group photo and make a promise: no matter how far apart you may be, one day you will all watch the stars together again.

You take part in the "Light Chaser Collection," a photography event organized by the Photography Fan Club, and use your camera to capture snapshots of student life. When you deliver the photos, the club leader, Lianna, gives you a record in return, hoping that the songs on it will accompany you through this bright and precious chapter of campus life.

A student named Daigo discovers that someone has been impersonating him at the Academy and asks you to track the impostor down. To everyone's surprise, the "Fake Daigo" turns out to be a formal B.1.N.G.O. unit disguised by I.R.I.S. It accomplishes what Daigo never had the courage to do, nudging him to confess to the girl he loves, Nanami, and to join the scientific expedition team. Now Daigo is chasing his dreams together with Nanami.

At the Academy, the renowned Professor Edgar is about to retire. His student, Frantz, wants to send him off with his own research: a grand fireworks display. But your choices, in ways unseen, will decide whether Frantz can make it to Edgar's farewell ceremony in time. When the sky finally erupts with fireworks, Professor Edgar tells him the truth: the man who always considered himself ordinary has, in fact, always been his proudest student.

Robbie, a Mechascout corrupted by the Void Storm and nearing the end of its service life, sets out with you to fulfill its final wishes. One by one, you help it do the small things it never had the chance to try. At the very end, it makes one last gesture. Showing both its love for the world and its longing to fly, it falls from the sky like a meteor, opening its mechanical arms toward the land that meant so much to it.

Together, Dari of the Roya people and you from Startorch Academy, restore the Spacetrek Collective's power supply and relight Roya petroglyphs so they can shine once more beneath Lahai-Roi's sky. Now, illuminated by the Collective's light, the petroglyphs are more than a work of Royan artistry. They have become a symbol of both peoples standing together to protect Lahai-Roi.

You bring Mr. Trevor, now old and unable to travel himself, the photographs you took from within the Void Storm. Though age has kept him from venturing out in person, he still wants to turn those magnificent images into postcards and send them to his friend, Mr. Fulmine, in Ragunna.

To explore whether a different holographic projection is possible, you and Mornye enter the "ocean" projected within the Submerged Tunnel. There, Mornye, who has never seen the ocean with her own eyes, makes you a promise: one day, she will see the real thing in person, with you beside her.

While helping Ero sort through a pile of odds and ends, you accidentally uncover a number of precious pre-Lament satellite data recorders. After some investigation, you learn they were gathered by a Flufftail Fox Ero once saved called "Fluffball," who tried to repay his kindness in its own way. To keep Ero's tent from becoming a junk heap again, and for the sake of future research, you contact the Spacetrek Collective and turn the recorders over to them.

A glitching order in the cafeteria's food machine leads you to a strange patch of blue snow in the frostlands. A research team, determined to study the frostlands' Cobalt Sediment structure, pushed into a hazardous zone and never returned. Following the clues left in the order records, you find the vehicle they once used, along with a non-standard component and their logs. The logs describe how their obsession with tracing the strange structure slowly drove them mad. I.R.I.S. recovers the component, and you decide it's best to let that cobalt dream remain buried beneath the snow.

Back to Lahai-Roi, Aemeath waits for you on a bench in the Academy. Now "reborn," she is ready to continue her studies there. One day, she hopes to travel farther and save even more people. As the two of you stroll through Lahai-Roi's spring breeze, you promise that no matter what path she chooses, you will always be proud of her.

Hiyuki speaks on behalf of Lucilla to let you know how things will be handled after the Aleph-1 incident. She also fills you in on what's happening in Ashinohara and what the Fractsidus have been up to lately. Their plan against her has failed, and after going through life-and-death situations by your side, she has finally let go of her wish to save Ashinohara all by herself.

At the request of Ham, the director of the Spacetrek Incubation Program, you help four research teams funded by the program push past their setbacks and finish their reports. Ham tells you that while their work may not seem groundbreaking, it's a crucial step forward on the path of scientific discovery. He believes that with the Academy's support, these students will one day rise like new stars and light up the skies above Lahai-Roi.

Zenus, a student whose proposal was rejected by the Spacetrek Incubation Program, still refuses to abandon his project. Determined to deepen humanity's understanding of Solaris, he plans to deploy high-sensitivity seismometers across the Dimmr Plains to map the region. You help him place the instruments at three of the most dangerous sites, while Ham, the very teacher who once turned him down, helps with the deployment of the remaining survey equipment. Once the data is successfully recovered, Zenus gets his drive back with your support and resolves to continue his relentless commitment to research.

Reynard, hoping to take a shortcut on his field assignment, gets tricked by a mysterious group known as the "Retrievers." Not only does he fail to finish the assignment, but he also gets swindled out of a large sum of money. He comes to you for help in finding out who the Retrievers really are. Together, you track down the people they once served. You discover that even when what they recovered was nothing more than a forgery, grieving people still clung to it for comfort. After you shut down the Retrievers' operation, a business built on profiting from people's sorrow, Reynard is deeply moved. He decides to become a true Retriever instead: someone who can recover what's been lost and help ease the pain of those who are grieving.

The Spacetrek Collective finishes sorting through the Fractsidus records recovered in the Dimmr Plains. Arman invites you to meet with him in person and shares what they found. From those materials, you finally learn the truth behind Denia's plan. Later, Sigrika tracks you down and tells you that before she left, Denia wrote her a letter confessing everything. Now that she knows the truth, Sigrika is finally able to accept her friend's decision to leave and face the future with renewed hope.

The past is not without meaning—it shapes our hopes for the future. While the past cannot be altered, it forms the foundation for paving a new path ahead. Break the chains of the past, and seize the promise of tomorrow—for those who have no future, for those who safeguard these shores, and... for yourself.

The Asura in the Hero Play wears a mask forged by her sinister thoughts. She struggles to resist it, yet sometimes uses its power for her own ends.
Occasionally, I fall into a trance on stage, as if I am the Asura exorcising evil spirits.
Maybe it's because you two share some similar pasts?
Maybe... The falling petals remind me of my past. I can't help but think that one day, the burning wishes I defend with my ice-cold blade will become a reality.
The theater audience seems captivated. They do appreciate a good Hero Play.
Winter shall come to pass, and the spring thaw will bring all things back to life... Perhaps that is the moral of the play.
Your goddess cameo in the final scene was spectacular.
Because you helped me rehearse. Would you like to have a stroll with me later?
This Hero Play is thoughtfully presented, and the characters have been carefully crafted with underlying symbolism.
The incorporation of so many nostalgic elements makes me wonder who the director is.
Well, you have a good eye for detail.
It doesn't really matter anyway. What matters is the joy of people {Male=he;Female=she} wished to see with this play. Don't you agree?
Heh, I like how you can snack in open-air theaters while the actors perform.
So, why'd you ask me to come here? Oh, I get it! Are you gonna treat me to some great meals for all the hard work I put into scattering those flowers?
What do you mean by typical? I'm one of a kind! Wait here. I have something for you.
I like how Asura chooses to defy the prophecy, her weapon of destruction becoming a vessel of blessings.
That scene was delightful. You've presented another precious opportunity to me.
Yes, an opportunity to explore something yet to be assessed with you. Speaking of which, how do you feel about a future collaboration?
Clearing the petals on stage must take a while, but I'm here to help.
Pero says she enjoyed that play. The story reminded her of all of us and made her feel warm and fuzzy.
Good, I thought you might have found it boring.
A play of hope is never dull. I'm feeling inspired. Want to hear my ideas?
With the blade in her hands, Asura cuts through her confusion to face the trials of destiny. Truly a grand adventure!
The performance is excellent and merits applause, but...
We still have to drink a toast to another better day! Are you up for a round, my friend？
I've never imagined that guests from Rinascita would also come to see this new Hero Play.
It was you who made this gathering possible, {PlayerName}.
I'm also surprised to see you acting as Asura in the play.
The lead actor had an unexpected issue, so I had to fill in with only a little time to rehearse. Fortunately, I managed to get most of the lines correct...
That dance of blessings was impressive.
Glad you liked it. I wonder what our guests from Rinascita think about the play.
The play is over, but not the festival. Why not enjoy the festive moments with others?
True, this is one of the biggest festivals of the year... So who should I invite first?

With the incident in Lahai-Roi coming to a close, you decide to revisit Huanglong, only to unexpectedly learn of Yangyang's disappearance. To find Yangyang, together with Yangyang's elder sister, Suisui, you head to the Land of Xuanfang located in Mengzhou to investigate. Yet at the same time, a crisis triggered by "Autopuppets" quietly brews in the Xuanfang...

After overcoming numerous obstacles, you and Suisui successfully find Yangyang and obtain the token left behind by Mengzhou's Sentinel, Hsin the Moon Fox. Following the clues, you delve deeper into Xuanfang, and the mastermind of this incident finally surfaces—an Artisan from Mengzhou's Zhuojun Atelier by the name of Muyu seeks to exploit the Sentinel's technology, manipulating Autopuppets to launch a mass attack on Xuanfang Hold.\nDuring the attempt to stop Muyu, Yangyang hears the "Streams" for the first time, and in direct confrontation with the massive Autopuppet "Thousand-Puppet Pavilion" Muyu created, she awakens new powers.\nHowever, after defeating the Thousand-Puppet Pavilion, you and Yangyang discover that the Muyu before you is merely a puppet, and his true self remains hidden somewhere in Xuanfang.

Days following the Autopuppet crisis, Yangyang chooses to stay in Xuanfang for some time to assist the soldiers and people there. While waiting for her Resonance Evaluation Report, the Streams brings Yangyang back to the Gorges of Spirits, recreating the moments when she first met you. The Streams addresses Yangyang as the "Votary of the Voice" and tells her that from this point forward, her true journey is only just beginning.

You encounter Suyu, an injured Midnight Ranger, in Xuanfang. After a brief chat, you learn that she is here on a mission as a Monitor, accompanying a unique Resonator. Taking this opportunity, you embark on an investigation into the crisis of the Skyworks alongside this Resonator, while also uncovering the mysteries that weigh upon her heart...

A malfunction Autopuppet sneaks into the Fogveil Pagoda, where you also happen to encounter a master and his apprentice, T-G0NG and Q-L1NG, who had been sealed away and faithfully maintained their duties for over a hundred years. T-G0NG and Q-L1NG were collecting data to conduct preliminary research on the functional structure of Xuanfang Hold, when the malfunction Autopuppet came to deliver a message: "Xuanfang Hold has already been completed, and the two of you can now rest."\nIn the end, you help the master and apprentice establish contact with the outside world, and the malfunction Autopuppet also frequently visits the Fogveil Pagoda to spend time with them.

Inside the Shadowcast Chamber of the Fogveil Pagoda, you use mechanisms to change the shape of shadows on the wall and solve the puzzle. These shadows seem to tell of the past when Hsin the Moon Fox dispatched Autopuppets to combat and sealed Tacet Discords in Censure Cages.

Inside the Hunting Chamber of the Ruby Shades, you discover traces left by the malfunction Autopuppet that had sneaked inside. Pursuing the illusions it left behind, you confirm that it eventually departed from here and returned to the Upper Foyer of the Fogveil Pagoda.

Inside the Puppet Chamber of the Fogveil Pagoda, you reassemble an Autopuppet. This Autopuppet was actually the administrator of the Fuming Archive Chamber, the Archival Autopuppet. After the assembly was complete, the Archival Autopuppet leaves the Fogveil Pagoda to search for a girl named Tianyue.

Inside the Fuming Archive Chamber of the Fogveil Pagoda, you encounter the mirage of a girl called Tianyue. At firts, she had sneaked into the Fogveil Pagoda to see her father, but unexpectedly formed a bond with the Archival Autopuppet here. In the gallery of Mechanisms displaying the past, you witness Tianyue's entire life: she frequently visited the Chamber during her childhood years till adulthood to stay in the Archival Autopuppet’s company, and after she passed away, the Archival Autopuppet also visited her grave to mourn.

Inside the Replica Chamber of the Fogveil Pagoda, yyou use mechanisms to alter the Model Boxes, thereby changing the structure of the entire Chamber and solving the puzzle. In the process, you discover that these Model Boxes were crafted by master and apprentice, T-G0NG and Q-L1NG, in the past.
